scope: One isolated local Stack lifecycle and Durable Chat public-contract flow. This is not Codex subscription-canary evidence and does not complete MOD-001 through MOD-005 or EX-001's restart/cancel coverage.

observations.ownership: Exactly one bootstrap-owned local namespace and one tools/dev up plus Tilt process pair were present during the accepted run.
observations.lifecycle: The bounded stack-reconcile resource was healthy after migration-runner and Temporal readiness; its append-only audit recorded an explicit m6-local-operator reconcile for the local/orbstack target.
observations.workloads: migration-runner, Temporal, runtime-api, and all three orchestration workers were Ready; the orchestration worker remained started on the declared per-stack Temporal task queue.
observations.durable_chat: The public terminal created a Session from an admin-created Agent revision, queued one Input, read a non-empty Product-event page/cursor, and resumed the Session. The API forward was stopped after the flow.

redaction: No kubeconfig bytes, generated Secret values, bearer tokens, request headers, raw input text, local state/capability files, raw pod logs, dashboard snapshots, or internal backend identifiers are retained.
